defs.def: to make sure that sb/sth is not harmed, injured, damaged, etc. 保护；防护

ex.s: Habitat Restoration Team volunteers play a vital role in restoring sensitive resources and protecting endangered species across the ridges and valleys.
ex.t: 栖息地修复小组的志愿者在恢复敏感资源、保护山岭与山谷间濒危物种方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

ex.s: To protect the local ecosystem.
ex.t: 保护当地生态系统。

ex.s: Technology can be introduced to protect grizzlies.
ex.t: 可以引入技术来保护灰熊。

ex.s: The ____49____ (remark) development of this city, which is consciously designed to protect the past while stepping into the modern world, _____50_____ (mean) there is always something new to discover here, and I could be photographing Beijing for the next 50 years.

ex.s: To protect them from dangers.
ex.t: 保护他们免受危险。

ex.s: Cao and Wu also collected garbage along the road, in order to promote environmental ___65___ (protect).

ex.s: To protect children’s health.

ex.s: To protect them from dangers.

ex.s: I decided to commit to completing the applications, and soon I was a part of a growing global team of young people working to protect nature.
ex.t: 我决定致力于完成申请，很快我就成为了一个不断壮大的全球青年保护自然团队的一员。

ex.s: The adorable female calf is the second black rhino born this year at the reserve, but it is too early to tell if the calves will make good candidates to be returned to protected areas of the wild.
ex.t: 这只可爱的雌性幼崽是今年保护区出生的第二头黑犀牛，但现在判断这些幼崽是否适合放归保护区的野外区域还为时过早。

ex.s: Some of its rhinos may be sent to the protected wild areas.
ex.t: 它的一些犀牛可能被送往受保护的野外区域。

ex.s: This is real rain-your umbrella may protect you in a shower, but it won't keep you dry if there is a full rainstorm.
ex.t: 仅两小时内，溪流就可以上涨十到二十英尺。

ex.s: To remind students to protect public property.
ex.t: 提醒学生保护公共财产。

ex.s: To make sure you get enough Vitamin D—but still protect your skin— put on sunscreen right as you head outside.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 为了确保你获得足够的维生素D——同时保护你的皮肤——出门时立即涂上防晒霜。

ex.s: But in comparing a study of California forests done in the 1920s and 1930s with another one between 2001 and 2010, Mclntyre and his colleagues documented a widespread death of big trees that was evident even in wildlands protected from woodcutting or development.
ex.t: 但麦金太尔和他的同事在比较20世纪20年代和30年代的加州森林研究与2001年至2010年之间的另一项研究时发现，即使在没有伐木或开发保护的荒野地区，大树的广泛死亡也是显而易见的。

ex.s: China’s approach to protecting its environment while   70   (feed) its citizens “offers useful lessons for agriculture and food policymakers worldwide,” says the bank’s Juergen Voegele.

ex.t: 我爬啊爬。除了绿色灌木丛和这些台阶什么都没有。我必须到达山顶！

ex.s: This is about making the shift from sedentary time to playtime, while ___27___ (protect) sleep.
ex.t: 常识媒体2016年进行的一项研究发现，父母每天在屏幕前花费多达9个小时，大多不是因为工作原因。

ex.s: Before the heavy lifting began, the team assessed the root system and dug a five-foot-deep cylinder , measuring 40 feet in diameter, around the trunk to protect all essential roots.

ex.s: Consumers could better protect their privacy.
ex.t: 消费者可以更好地保护隐私。

ex.s: Protecting the glaciers from melting.
ex.t: 保护冰川不被融化。

ex.s: When vaccination rates are very high, as they still are in the nation as a whole, everyone is protected.
ex.t: 父母应该只能出于有限的医疗或宗教原因选择不接种疫苗。

ex.s: This is called “herd immunity”, which protects the people who get hurt easily, including those who can’t be vaccinated for medical reasons, babies too young to get vaccinated and people on whom the vaccine doesn’t work.
ex.t: 但个人观点？

ex.s: The team discovered that some synapses seem to be protected and stayed the same size.
ex.t: 团队发现某些突触似乎受到了保护，保持了相同的尺寸。

ex.s: More and more people feel that by using natural dyes, we can remind ourselves of nature's beauty and protect the natural world.
ex.t: 越来越多的人觉得，通过使用天然染料，我们可以提醒自己大自然之美，并保护自然世界。

ex.s: Learning more about the animals with which we share the planet is key to helping protect them.
ex.t: 更多地了解与我们共享这个星球的动物，是帮助保护它们的关键。

ex.s: From that day on, he fought to protect sharks.
ex.t: 从那天起，他为保护鲨鱼而奋斗。

ex.s: Today, as we learn more about sharks, more people than ever want to protect them from extinction.
ex.t: 今天，随着我们对鲨鱼了解的增多，比以往任何时候都多的人想要保护它们免于灭绝。

ex.s: Lin Feng: Our job is to protect and restore the natural environment.
ex.t: 林峰：我们的工作是保护和恢复自然环境。

defs.def: to introduce laws that make it illegal to kill, harm or damage a particular animal, area of land, building, etc. （制订法律）保护

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 自1934年以来，已有超过五亿美元进入该基金，购买了超过500万英亩的栖息地。

ex.s: Depending on which role you choose，you could help to increase a community's access to safe drinking water，or help to protect valuable local cultures.

ex.s: “Basically, the provincial government is letting the insurance companies protect the Calgary-Edmonton urban area from hail,” Mr Stienwand says, “but they’re increasing drought risk as far east as Saskatchewan.”
